title: Frame-watching critique loop
what_it_does: Contact sheet, strip around fast moves and phone-width sheet, then a 1-10 score on hook, readability at 360 px, motion quality, variety, composition, accuracy, sound sync, listing the three worst problems with timestamps.
when_to_use: Review step before delivering any render.
why: Own Playwright pipeline, not HyperFrames, but this checklist is renderer-neutral and short. Merge with the Gauntlet prompts below into one check part.
